subject: Request: Access artifacts for tenant onboarding (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <compliance@apexmed.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Derek Shaw <procurement@apexmed.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Access artifacts for tenant onboarding (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for kicking off the onboarding process. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review and SOC2 intake we need a focused set of access control artifacts specific to the new tenant you will be provisioning for ApexMed. Can you please provide the following (we've prioritized them):

- SAML / IdP assertion samples for a user login (including attribute mapping)
- SCIM provisioning delta/export (last 30 days) or a representative snapshot
- RBAC role matrix for the tenant (roles, default permissions, service accounts)
- A short statement (1 page) on least-privilege controls you apply when creating tenant-scoped roles
- Any evidence of admin/owner separation for tenant provisioning (audit snapshots or owner roster)

Target timeline: we'd like to have these artifacts in the intake packet by EOD 2025-04-24 to stay on our audit calendar. If there's anything that can't be redacted (PII) let us know and we can agree on redaction level.

Also flag if we need separate prod vs staging tenant evidence (we can accept representative artifacts if there is policy alignment).

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Compliance, ApexMed Health
compliance@apexmed.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <compliance@apexmed.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Access artifacts for tenant onboarding (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Hi Lena —

Appreciate the clear list. We're able to assemble a focused packet that hits the items you listed. Quick notes and proposed plan:

- We'll produce SAML assertion samples (sanitized) + attribute mapping (text) and a 1-page explanation of mapping semantics.
- We'll include a SCIM delta snapshot for the last 30 days; if you prefer an aggregated export instead of raw deltas we can provide that too.
- RBAC matrix will include tenant roles and a short rationale for each (least-privilege intent).
- Admin/owner separation: we'll attach an owner roster export and a short timeline showing who initiated the tenant provisioning.

Internal owners: Irene will take point on SCIM exports and redaction, Ben will coordinate artifact delivery and legal/PO/Docusign items for any access agreements.

We can deliver an initial artifact pack by 2025-04-23 AM (we expect to have the bulk of items ready). If you still need EOD 04/24 that's fine; we can prioritize the SAML + RBAC first.

Irene / Ben — can you confirm redaction approach and whether we should provide raw CSVs or packaged zip with a README for ApexMed?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Lead, Security & Compliance (Onboarding)
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <compliance@apexmed.com>, Derek Shaw <procurement@apexmed.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Apr 2025 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Access artifacts for tenant onboarding (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Naomi / Team —

Quick update from procurement side and what I'll attach:

Attachments (prep):
- iam_artifact_pack_v1.zip (folder structure + README)
- saml-assertion-samples.txt (sanitized examples)
- scim-delta-log-snapshot.csv (redacted UIDs; includes timestamps and change types)
- rbac-role-matrix.xlsx (role -> permission mapping + owner column)

Redaction: Irene will strip email addresses and replace with pseudonyms; we will keep user ids hashed but will include mapping keys in a separate, access-controlled document if ApexMed requests them.

Delivery method: I'll upload the artifact pack to a restricted Drive folder and send a link + HS record (HubSpot HS-23456) and we can use DocuSign for any access attestation if procurement requires it.

Notes: If ApexMed requests a signed attestation for least-privilege controls, we can provide a short letter from Security summarizing our provisioning guardrails.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <compliance@apexmed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Derek Shaw <procurement@apexmed.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Apr 2025 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Access artifacts for tenant onboarding (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Lena —

Thanks again for the list. We've uploaded the artifact pack and attached the most relevant files here. Summary of what you'll find in the package:

1) SAML assertion samples (saml-assertion-samples.txt) — three login flows: user, admin, and service-account. Attributes are labeled and we've included the IdP mapping table.
2) SCIM delta snapshot (scim-delta-log-snapshot.csv) — last 30 days, hashed user IDs, change types, and timestamps. Irene has added a redaction notes file inside the zip.
3) RBAC role matrix (rbac-role-matrix.xlsx) — role names, permission sets, description, default tenant assignments, and the owning team member.
4) Admin/owner export — owner roster (redacted) + provisioning event timeline.
5) README inside iam_artifact_pack_v1.zip describing each file, expected redaction level, and contact points.

Delivery link: https://drive.redwood.example.com/s/Onboarding/IAM/ApexMed-Artifact-Pack
HubSpot: HS-23456

Next steps: please confirm whether the redaction level is acceptable and whether you require a signed attestation letter. If everything looks good, Ben will loop in Legal for DocuSign on the access attestation.

If you need evidence separated by environment (prod vs staging), tell us which artifacts you need duplicated and we'll scope that as a follow-up.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Lead, Security & Compliance (Onboarding)
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142
